items.title: 68436_Alberta Hunter oral history interview
items.q: Mamie Carter, she could sing a little... So anyhow, Goldie Crosby could sing a little. Mamie Carter, she could sing a little, and then Nellie Carr used to do a dance...

ctx.x: Mr. Carter was in it, because they had a quartet in "How Come." And Mr. Todd was in that quartet. A beautiful quartet. Yes, he was in that show. Mr. Todd, I'm trying -- I don't know, I don't know who else -- who the other singers were. But Mr. Todd -- there was a quartet, and he was -- because they were like the waiters. Because "How Come" was a show -- Eddie Hunter was a marvelous comedian, one of those intelligent comedians, you know. Funny, but -- and he had whiskey would be brown sugar would be whiskey. And…

-- what did they call it? Milk. Milk and sugar, I think. But anyhow, I'll look all that up and tell you about it, hear? And they had -- you'd sit on the bottles, like they were seats for you. And the police would come, we'd run and sit down on those bottles.
